_comment: Configurable inputs. Section 6 of the brief requires the gross margin and the payment
failure rate to be adjustable rather than baked in. Section 11 records that the gross
margin is not yet confirmed by Raj, which is why grossMargin.confirmed is false: the
dashboard presents a sensitivity range and says so, rather than presenting a single

grossMargin.confirmationNote: Section 11 item 1. Awaiting Raj. The business overview cites roughly 30% margin on equipment, which is context, not confirmation. Until confirmed, LTV:CAC is a sensitivity range, not a figure.

paymentFailureRate.note: Risk adjusted revenue discounts the weekly payment stream by this rate. Delivery and install are not discounted: they are collected once, up front, not as part of the weekly stream.

terms._comment: Read the term from the deal. These are defaults used only when the deal does not carry one, and their use is always reported.

depositStructures._comment: First number is weeks of rent in advance, second is weeks of security bond. Neither is incremental revenue. See the revenue rule.

region._comment: Rent and Lease to Own are Auckland region only. Out of region leads are flagged, not silently counted.

currency._comment: Every figure in this dashboard is ex GST. The gstRate is recorded for reference only. Nothing in the pipeline computes a GST inclusive figure.
